description: Identity reference binding for one character in one production (CF-WO-P1-006-R2-PREFLIGHT, v2.5, additive). The binding is the approved frontal reference plus 1-3 additional angle references that the provider elements array is built from: the same approved references on every shot containing the character, and no elements entry on a shot without the character. Only an approved reference with a recorded transmission permission may be transmitted; a pending or missing reference blocks the plan and is never silently substituted. The provider limit of at most 3 additional references is enforced by the runtime (the schema subset cannot express a maximum count); the minimum of 1 is enforced here. No identity preservation is claimed to be perfect: whether generated frames kept the identity is decided afterwards by human review of real frames.

additional_references.description: Additional angle references (1-3; the elements reference_image_urls). At least one is required; at most 3 are supported by the provider.
